title: Thread Finder Maplet — prototype for inline trace map with rollout & cost anchors
text:
Thread Finder Maplet — prototype for inline trace map with rollout & cost anchors

description:
Design and prototype a lightweight inline trace navigator ("Thread Finder Maplet") to help engineers rapidly locate high-cost or rollout-affected requests within a long timeline. The maplet is an embeddable UI element that sits above request details and provides an at-a-glance density map of spans, cost hotspots, and rollout flags tied to correlation IDs.

background:
Our Console users request faster triage when an alert points to a broad time window or to many correlated requests (eg. during canary rollouts). Current trace inspector flows require drilling into each request which is slow when patterns are spread across time and variants. The maplet aims to reduce trial-and-error by surfacing density, cost, and rollout markers in a compact, interactive visualization.

goals:
Enable locating suspicious request clusters within 30s without opening >5 drill-downs
Surface per-request estimated token cost hotspots inline
Show rollout flags and ability to jump to requests part of a canary cohort
Preserve full fidelity: clicking maplet pins opens the standard trace inspector at exact span and time

non_goals:
Replace full trace timeline canvas; this is a navigational aid
Implement complex root-cause ML detection within prototype

user_stories:
As an SRE, I want to find all requests from the new model rollout that spiked cost in the last hour so I can roll back the variant
As a backend engineer, I want to jump from an alert to representative traces clustered by latency and cost
As a product engineer, I want to annotate a time range to link to a specific rollout event

constraints:
Maplet must render quickly (<=100ms) on pages with >200 requests
Must avoid additional backend calls per render for list pages; use existing aggregated telemetry API
Must be keyboard accessible and work with screen readers at a basic level

proposed_interactions:
Mini heatline with density bands: intensity = number of spans / request
Cost badges: small colored ticks (green/amber/red) scaled by per-request token estimate
Rollout anchors: dashed vertical markers with variant label; hover reveals cohort size and ratio of errors
Brush selection: drag to zoom an interactive time window; on release the request list filters to that range
Click-to-pin: pins open a small preview pane with top 3 spans and direct link to full trace inspector
Context menu on markers: ‘Open in inspector’, ‘Create follow-up issue’, ‘Annotate timeline’

design_assets:
Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/Redwood/Thread-Finder-Maplet-Prototype
Prototype (interactive): https://www.invisionapp.com/share/RWI-Maplet-Prototype
Mockup PNGs: maplet_states_v1.png, maplet_brush_hover.png

decisions:
Use existing aggregated telemetry endpoint (telemetry/requests/summary) rather than calling trace inspector per request
Show cost as normalized 3-tier scale (low/medium/high) for clarity in the mini-map
Rollout anchors will link to the Console rollout page using rollout id; secondary action shows cohort filter

next_steps:
Engineering spike: implement telemetry endpoint prototype (owner: Ethan Brooks) - due 2026-03-05
Design iterate: update Figma to incorporate color and a11y fixes (owner: Aisha Kumar) - due 2026-03-03
Dev handoff: prep component API doc and storybook entry (owner: Dev Team) - due 2026-03-10

tasks:
Design: finalize micro-interaction spec for brush and pin states
Eng: build lightweight maplet React component and storybook stories
API: extend telemetry summary endpoint to include rollout labels and estimated token cost
QA: write regression tests verifying keyboard navigation and brush selection filtering
Docs: add quickstart snippet to Console docs explaining maplet usage

acceptance_criteria:
Maplet renders on a real customer org with 1k requests in <200ms on standard laptop
Brush selection filters the requests list and opens pinned preview on click
Rollout anchors correctly resolve to rollout page and pre-filter request list to cohort
Cost badges align with backend token estimates in 95% of sampled requests
Accessibility: maplet controls reachable by keyboard and have descriptive aria labels

progress_updates:
2026-02-20: Initial exploration sketches completed; shared with PM and infra. Consensus to proceed with a small map that uses aggregated histograms.
2026-02-24: Engineering spike started; mock telemetry payload agreed (histogram + anchors array).
2026-03-02: First interactive prototype uploaded to InVision; prioritized color/a11y fixes from review.
2026-03-05: Design review meeting: stakeholders accepted concept; approved for engineering alpha with optimistic estimate of 2 sprints.

review_feedback:
2026-02-22 - Jonah Park: Prefer a single-pass color scale for cost to avoid misinterpreting severity; recommended color palette attached
2026-02-25 - Marisol Vega (PM): Add explicit mapping between rollout anchors and console rollout config so users can click from maplet to rollout details
2026-02-27 - Priya Menon (Eng): Suggest server-side aggregation endpoint with pre-rolled histogram to keep client JS light
2026-03-01 - Accessibility review (Lena Ortiz): Ensure brush control exposes aria-labels and keyboard incremental steps

notes:
We must coordinate with Rollouts team to add a lightweight index of rollout->request ids for fast cohort resolution.
Prototype intentionally limits detail to avoid replicate of full trace inspector; maintain single responsibility: navigation and surface-level context.
